newsitem.title: USA: Boeing polls Americans on McDonnell merger.
newsitem.headline: Boeing polls Americans on McDonnell merger.

text.p: Boeing Co said on Thursday that most Americans believe that the European Union should not be able to block its proposed merger with McDonnell Douglas Corp.
A majority of 1,062 people questioned in a nationwide telephone poll on July 8 and July 9 also said the U.S. government should retaliate possible EU action against the merger.

The poll asked: "If the Europeans started to seize Boeing assets such as planes or imposing multi-billion dollar fines because of the merger, actions their laws permit them to do, should the U.S. government accept it or retaliate against the Europeans for such actions?"
Boeing reported that seven in ten favored retaliation.
The European Union is considering whether to permit the $14 billion merger. If Boeing were to defy a negative decision and merge anyway, the EU could apply sanctions.
A Boeing spokesman said that the poll did not ask whether the United States should be allowed to blmergers.
